newsitem.title: USA: Tiffany reports record sales for quarter.
newsitem.headline: Tiffany reports record sales for quarter.

text.p: Tiffany & Co. said Wednesday its earnings jumped 40 percent in the latest quarter, thanks to stronger sales.

The upscale jeweller and speciality retailer said it earned $35.7 million, or $1.00 or share, in its fiscal fourth quarter ended on Jan. 31, compared with year-earlier profits of $25.4 million, or 74 cents a share. Sales rose 17 percent to $327.6 million from $280.7 million.

For the year, Tiffany said its earnings soared 49 percent to $58.4 million, or $1.66 a share, on sales of $922.1 million, compared with earnings of $39.2 million, or $1.19 a share, on sales of $803.2 million.
The company said U.S. sales in the fourth quarter were up 14 percent to $151.5 million, and increased 16 percent in 1996 to $424.1 million.
Direct Marketing sales were up 11 percent to $37.0 million for the quarter and rose 8 percent to $100.5 million in 1996.
International sales increased 21 percent to $139.0 milllion and rose 15 percent for the year to $397.3 million.
Tiffany's stock was unchanged at $37.125 on the New York Stock Exchange.
